name: FatboyInfo
short: Personalized FATBOY profile, stats, loaded cogs, and reversible ~info override.
description: Displays a custom Discord embed with owner, uptime, version, server/member counts, gateway latency, loaded cogs and bot avatar. Replaces Red Core's info command safely, restores it on unload, and provides ~fatboy when another cog owns ~info. Owner-only configuration commands.
author: Will
North
end_user_data_statement: Stores only bot-owner-configured display label, public description, accent color and alias toggle. Does not collect or store Discord end-user data.
